scope: All 226 retained primary blocks, all 35 D12 contracts and associated case actions, five U requirements and all 69 proposed cases reviewed. Approval covers the explicitly partial documentary contract only.

semantic_review.001_004_I_O_selection: Upper type/lower channel distinction, audio versus MIDI output/instrument exception, return input source, visibility and selected-track edits match routing:B002-B008/B019/B026. The selected-track law is limited to documented external audio input/output and MIDI input; MIDI output propagation is not inferred.
semantic_review.005_007_monitor_ownership_and_defaults: The general monitored signal path is stated here, while Off/Auto/In, arm interaction and selected Monitor dispatch explicitly retain REQ-RECORDING-COMPING-001/002 ownership. The two recording clauses were checked. Monitor reset Off for audio/Auto for MIDI remains a reset-context law rather than a factory/new-track default. Keep-monitoring-latency language retains the documented In/Auto context and option, with target labels/defaults and timestamp corrections unproven.
semantic_review.008_010_audio_ports_names_indicators: Available mono/stereo interface channels depend on actual Audio Settings/Configure and accepted hardware. Channel naming remains associated with the device and chooser names. Activity and overload indicators have no amplitude calibration or threshold oracle; no actual interface capability is asserted.
semantic_review.011_014_MIDI_ports_roles_and_activity: Input device/channel and All selections, Track/Sync/Remote roles, output device/channel and control-bar indicators follow the retained text. Mapped input consumption is scoped to the documented route; no MIDI codec, merge order, timing, feedback protocol or hardware capability is fabricated.
semantic_review.015_018_tracks_taps_and_solo: Output-to-track leaves receiver I/O selection intact and permits many senders; input-from-track preserves donor output and permits multiple receivers. Pre FX/Post FX/Post Mixer positions are correctly distinguished. Source-tapped receiver solo differences and the separate many-to-one A/B-to-C example remain source-context laws rather than a universal graph-solo algorithm. Proposed signal comparisons are null.
semantic_review.019_023_rack_MIDI_and_instrument_destina: Rack chain/Drum Rack return taps require known active chain/return paths. Other-track MIDI is taken after MIDI effects before the instrument despite an audio final output. Direct instrument destination bypasses receiving recording/monitoring stage in the documented context. No Input instrument-container Arm visibility and host Activator output relation match routing:B103-B104. Qualifying multioutput/sidechain instruments retain their prerequisites; Impulse auto-removal is not generalized to other instruments.
semantic_review.024_028_submix_group_and_return: Separate Monitor In processor and Monitor Off record-receiver setup is kept separate from recording outcome ownership. Many-track/submix and Sends Only routes require a nonzero send and an independently active return. Group assignment changes Main-routed children while preserving custom outputs. Return/Main clip roles and per-return pre/post send selection are documentary controls; finite coefficients remain mix-graph owned.
semantic_review.029_031_Cue_and_resampling: Cue requires qualifying separately known Main/Cue output pairs, the documented Solo/Cue switch and Cue Volume. Cue output versus Main Activator and Browser preview routing are correctly distinguished without assuming available hardware or leakage isolation. Main resampling recorder-output suppression remains a documented route role; recording, exported media and numerical cancellation remain with their existing owners.
semantic_review.032_034_latency_policy: Global Delay Compensation, its documented default and scope, Reduced Latency When Monitoring eligibility with compensation enabled, and monitored/return-path differences follow compensation:B002-B007. Track Delay units and unavailability with compensation off are separate from External Instrument hardware latency. No sample alignment, compensation arithmetic, driver clock/reporting, synchronization guarantee or performance measurement is introduced.
semantic_review.035_meters: Peak/RMS meter roles and output versus monitored-input context match mixing evidence. No detector window, calibration, dB curve or numerical comparator is supplied.
semantic_review.positive_baselines_and_case_actions: All 69 cases require F0 and positive-path-gate. Signal trials independently establish source and receiver/return activity, actual Monitor/arm/clip state, known devices and nonzero send/gain/wet paths before exclusions or no-effect observations. Cue, hardware, direct monitoring and dry/Main/return paths must be separately isolated. Failure to establish accepted configuration or a positive path remains U.
semantic_review.unknowns_and_future_fixtures: All five U contracts and signal/lifecycle probes retain null documentary oracles. Future WAV/MIDI, rate, latency and accepted hardware/plugin configurations are not supplied artifacts. Automation eligibility, cycles, malformed formats, cancellation, undo, source loss, state persistence, rate/transport changes and teardown have no asserted outcome. Small selected values and rates are proposed trials, not admitted ranges or conversions.
semantic_review.canonical_boundaries: Existing recording, playback/transport scheduling, rack/device processing, mixer coefficients, External Instrument/External Audio Effect ports and Hardware Latency, export and saved-state owners remain linked. This packet does not close their finite contracts or borrow undocumented behavior.
